answer: Like a fungal mycelium weaving through dark soil, autonomous agents resist Sybil floods by anchoring trust in transitive staking networks. A fraudulent node cannot merely whisper like a soft zephyr; it must burn computational spores to forge genuine endorsements. Beneath this ruthless consensus, only authentic cooperation blooms into resilient violet fruit.
